speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to begin our assessment, are these spells triggered by specific head movements or changes in position?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The history of sudden, position-dependent vertigo in a 70-year-old with presbycusis is highly suggestive of BPPV. To confirm this, do you have a history of head trauma or recent ear infections?
